recipes.name: Cold Cure inspired by Kenan & Kel
instructions: DO NOT TRY THIS AT HOME

In a blender, place pieces of fried chicken, handful of unraveled cough drops, whole raw eggs including the shells, sardines, a few drops of hot sauce, marshmallows, a generous squeeze of yellow mustard, pickle juice and covering all the ingredients with orange soda. - 2 pieces fried chicken - 9 cough drops unwrapped - 2 whole eggs - 2 sardines - Hot sauce (Tapatio) - 4 marshmallows - Yellow mustard - Orange Soda - ½ cup pickle juice
Blend together until all the ingredients have been blended together into a smoothie like texture.
